unverified: Production login/password provisioning and migration application to existing flint database are intentionally not performed.
Backup restore must rotate incarnation; PostgreSQL restores stored revision and incarnation from its backup.
This run uses SET SESSION AUTHORIZATION for the disposable nonowner LOGIN; password authentication is not exercised.
